title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-4.5 System Card
summary: OpenAI is releasing a research preview of GPT-4.5, described as their largest and most knowledgeable model yet.
why_included: This is a high-impact release announcement of OpenAI's GPT-4.5 model, positioned as their largest and most knowledgeable to date.

title: OpenAI banned accounts linked to deceptive employment schemes
summary: OpenAI banned accounts potentially used to facilitate a deceptive employment scheme with characteristics of North Korea-linked IT-worker activity, using AI for material development.
why_included: This reveals AI's involvement in sophisticated employment scams and OpenAI's enforcement actions against such fraudulent activities.

title: OpenAI banned China-linked accounts using AI for surveillance planning
summary: OpenAI banned likely China-origin accounts using AI to draft surveillance-tool pitches, analyze documents, and debug code, identified as Operation 'Peer Review'.
why_included: This exposes AI's use in facilitating surveillance operations by Chinese actors and OpenAI's detection and banning of such activities.

title: OpenAI banned Cambodian accounts using AI for fake review job scams
summary: OpenAI banned accounts appearing to originate in Cambodia that used AI to translate messages for fake-review job scams, requiring victims to pay fees, known as Task scam.
why_included: This highlights AI's use in facilitating financial scams targeting individuals through fake job offers and OpenAI's actions against these fraudulent operations.

title: OpenAI banned Rwanda-origin accounts using AI for election content
summary: OpenAI banned Rwanda-origin accounts using AI to generate partisan comments ahead of the country’s elections, identified as Rwandan election content.
why_included: This illustrates AI's use in political interference and shaping electoral narratives, with OpenAI taking action against such manipulation.

title: OpenAI banned Iran-linked accounts using AI for influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned Iran-linked accounts associated with the IUVM operation using AI to generate and translate pro-Iran, anti-Israel, and anti-US website content.
why_included: This details AI's application in geopolitical influence operations by Iran and OpenAI's enforcement measures against these activities.

title: Google Gemini Pro Now Generally Available
summary: Google Gemini Pro is now generally available to developers via API, offering advanced AI capabilities for various applications.
why_included: The general availability of Gemini Pro expands access to Google's advanced AI models, potentially driving adoption and new use cases.
